description: Verification at 50 decimal digits of the Kummer reflection formula Li_3(z) - Li_3(1/z) = -log³(-z)/6 - π²log(-z)/6 evaluated at z = ζ_5 = exp(2πi/5). Yields the closed form Im Li_3(ζ_5) = 4π³/125 — a Tate-rational depth-3 number, projecting to zero under the Beilinson regulator quotient. Sharpening of conj:bring-trilog-depth-3-witness: only the real part Cl_3(2π/5) is the genuinely new depth-3 element.
interpretation: Im Li_3(ζ_5) is Tate-rational (4π³/125), in (2πi)³·ℚ. Under Beilinson's regulator quotient P_3 → P_3/Tate, this component vanishes. Only Re Li_3(ζ_5) = Cl_3(2π/5) ≈ 0.18937 carries genuinely new depth-3 information. Reduces the 2-dim Bring trilog content to the single real-part component for the regulator image.
consequence_for_b1: The 2-dim K_5^ind(Q(ζ_5)) ⊗ Q (Borel rank 2) has its Beilinson regulator image generated by Re Li_3(ζ_5^k) for k = 1, 2 (one independent value mod orbit-sum, with conjugate pair Re Li_3(ζ_5^4) = Re Li_3(ζ_5)). Dim 2 confirmed by Galois-orbit + reality constraint.
